title: coefficientHeart_commonStratification_lisse
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a Noetherian scheme. Let $\Lambda$ be either the condensed ring associated to a finite intermediate field $\mathbf Q_\ell\subset E\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ or the condensed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Write $\Lambda_Y$ for the pulled-back coefficient ring on the pro-etale site of a scheme $Y$. Lisse means locally finite free on a pro-etale cover [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]. (1) If $i:S\to X$ and $j:T\to S$ are immersions and $M$ is a lisse $\Lambda_S$-module, then $j^*M$ is lisse. (2) Let $P$ and $R$ be finite locally closed scheme stratifications of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification], and let $M$ be a $\Lambda_X$-module with a finite constant local model on every scheme stratum of $P$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. If every stratum image of $R$ is contained in a stratum image of $P$, then the restriction of $M$ to every scheme stratum of $R$ is lisse. No morphism from a refined stratum to an original stratum is assumed; their given scheme structures are retained.

source.place: (2), restriction of lisse modules and lisse restrictions on every refinement

proof.text: Pullback preserves lisse coefficient modules: apply the existing locFree_pullback lemma, which base changes a trivializing cover and transports the finite-free isomorphisms through the pullback-composition comparison.

A finite constant local model is locally finitely presented. Apply the exact inverse image from the point to a finite presentation: it preserves the regular module, finite biproducts and cokernels. Transport the resulting finite presentation across the local-model isomorphism and the normalized-pullback comparison.

Undo the normalized coefficient comparison on the adapted stratum to obtain local finite presentation of the raw inverse image of M over the inverse-image ring. Apply localFinitePresentation_upperStar_of_range_subset to the immersion of the adapted stratum and the immersion of the refined stratum, using exactly the containment of their images. Normalize the coefficient comparison on the refined stratum again. The existing transfer theorem forms the fibre product, pulls presentations back, and reflects them through its surjective closed projection; no scheme-theoretic factorization is assumed.

An immersion into a Noetherian scheme has a Noetherian underlying space. In the finite-subfield and algebraic-closure coefficient cases apply respectively finite_lf and algcl_lf from the existing constructible-Serre module. These turn local finite presentation into a finite-free pro-etale cover. Transport raw pullbacks to normalized coefficient pullbacks with free_standardPullback. This proves lisse restriction on every refined stratum.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientHeart_commonStratification_lisse
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) RingCat.{u + 1})
    [IsCommMonObj (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ)] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (hΛ : (∃ E : IntermediateField ℚ_[ℓ] (PadicAlgCl ℓ),
      FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E ∧ Λ = Profinite.padicSubfieldCondensedRing ℓ E) ∨
      Λ = Profinite.padicAlgClCondensedRing ℓ) :
    (∀ (S T : Scheme.{u}) (i : S ⟶ X), IsImmersion i →
      ∀ j : T ⟶ S, IsImmersion j →
      ∀ M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj
        (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) S),
        IsLisseCoefficientModule (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) M →
          IsLisseCoefficientModule (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) ((CondensedRing.upperStar
            (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) j).obj M)) ∧
    (∀ (P R : X.FiniteLocallyClosedStratification)
      (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj
        (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) X)),
      (∀ a : Fin P.n,
        HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) (P.domain a)
          ((CondensedRing.upperStar (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) (P.immersion a)).obj M)) →
      (∀ a : Fin R.n, ∃ b : Fin P.n, R.stratum a ⊆ P.stratum b) →
        ∀ a : Fin R.n,
          IsLisseCoefficientModule (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) ((CondensedRing.upperStar
            (coefficientHeartRingObj Λ) (R.immersion a)).obj M))
